title: Paste Text Without the Formatting Mess
description: A real Chromium demonstration of pasting copied rich text as plain text with Ctrl+Shift+V.
hook: Keep the words. Leave the surprise formatting behind.

scenes.headline: SAME WORDS. NO MESS.
scenes.narration: Here is the result: clean text, with none of the borrowed formatting.
scenes.caption: Clean text immediately.

scenes.headline: COPY THE FORMATTED TEXT
scenes.narration: Copy the styled text normally. This is where fonts usually begin their unauthorized field trip.
scenes.caption: Copy as usual.

scenes.headline: PASTE WITH CTRL SHIFT V
scenes.narration: Click the destination, then press Control Shift V. Chromium pastes the words as plain text.
scenes.caption: Ctrl Shift V pastes plain text.

scenes.headline: FORMATTING DECLINED
scenes.narration: Same words. Your document keeps its own style. A small victory over collaborative typography.
scenes.caption: Your formatting survives.
